fib: ______ is a set of official instructions or statement of purpose.
mandate
A mandate is a set of official instructions or statement of purpose.
______ is the apex regulatory authority of the financial system.
CBN
The CBN is the apex regulatory authority of the financial system.
______ are known to be lax in their monitoring of the operations of these institutions, due to the fact that they are conniving to subvert the law regulating the institutions (see Okogbule, 2007).
Inspectorate and Compliance Officers

Inspectorate and Compliance Officers are known to be lax in their monitoring of the operations of these institutions, due to the fact that they are conniving to subvert the law regulating the institutions (see Okogbule, 2007).
______ is a system established by the Government to protect depositors against the loss of their insured deposits (NDIC, 2017).
Deposit Insurance
Deposit Insurance is a system established by the Government to protect depositors against the loss of their insured deposits (NDIC, 2017).
______ is the most vulnerable asset of a bank and must therefore be guarded jealously.
Cash
Cash is the most vulnerable asset of a bank and must therefore be guarded jealously.
______ is the responsibility of three departments, namely, the Bank Examination Department (BED), the Insurance and Surveillance Department (ISD) and Special Insured Institutions Department (SIID).
Bank Supervision in the NDIC

Bank Supervision in the NDIC is the responsibility of three departments, namely, the Bank Examination Department (BED), the Insurance and Surveillance Department (ISD) and Special Insured Institutions Department (SIID).
______ is a set of principles designed to guide behaviour.
Code of ethics
Code of ethics is a set of principles designed to guide behaviour.
______ is a self-sustaining financial institution owned and managed within a community to provide financial services to that community.
community bank in Nigeria
A community bank in Nigeria is a self-sustaining financial institution owned and managed within a community to provide financial services to that community.
______ is a statutory Committee comprising of regulators in the Nigerian financial services sector (the banking sector, the capital market, the insurance sector, the pension sector).
FSRCC
The FSRCC is a statutory Committee comprising of regulators in the Nigerian financial services sector (the banking sector, the capital market, the insurance sector, the pension sector).
______ is a very vital aspect of banking operations which must be closely monitored because of its importance not only for the stability of the banking system but also that of the entire economy.
Liquidity
Liquidity is a very vital aspect of banking operations which must be closely monitored because of its importance not only for the stability of the banking system but also that of the entire economy.
______ is a deliberate act of deception in order to gain some kind of benefits.
Fraud
Fraud is a deliberate act of deception in order to gain some kind of benefits.
______ is an essential element of the Nigeria deposit insurance scheme as it seeks to reduce the potential risk of failure and ensures the unsafe and unsound banking practices do not go unchecked.
Banking supervision

Banking supervision is an essential element of the Nigeria deposit insurance scheme as it seeks to reduce the potential risk of failure and ensures the unsafe and unsound banking practices do not go unchecked.
______ is a special, non-bank financial institution intervenes in mobilizing funds for investments in securities in response to the liquidity of the system.
discount house
A discount house is a special, non-bank financial institution intervenes in mobilizing funds for investments in securities in response to the liquidity of the system.
______ refers to the criminal act of illegally obtaining or attempting to obtain money or other assets from a bank or other financial institution.
Bank fraud
Bank fraud refers to the criminal act of illegally obtaining or attempting to obtain money or other assets from a bank or other financial institution.
______ refers to the incentive for excessive risk taking by banks or those receiving the benefit of protection.
Moral hazard
Moral hazard refers to the incentive for excessive risk taking by banks or those receiving the benefit of protection.
